head: 7113eed

smoke.notes: Honest negative: the repo-root `node smoke.mjs` FAILS (dba/driver.mjs:20 imports TASKS from dba/sheet.mjs which no longer exports it — SyntaxError). The canonical smoke path in README (experiments/smoke.mjs) is green: 13 canonical cells, boundary 1585 ok / 1586 refuse, no-lookahead, jev mock execute/discard, growth beta1 -1 -> 1, qrc labeled live:false, receipt chain seals+verifies.

essence: Developmental agent as 12-cell seed sheet: growth, conservation law, honest gates.

ideas.name: Nothing new at the substrate, everything at the declaration
ideas.statement: The claim under test: the quilt engine already contains every primitive needed to GROW an agent — the sheet is the contract, pure integer kernels are the substance, and the receipt chain records the substrate selection.

ideas.name: A forager that senses, predicts and reflexes
ideas.statement: Z_in salience sensors, a JEPA momentum predictor with integer L1 surprise, and a pincher fast path (salience > 800 orients with no teacher) feed a reflex-override policy.

ideas.name: Growth and curriculum are gated, not rewarded
ideas.statement: Stage position accumulates only while surprise DECLINES; at threshold the sheet literally grows (stage-2 cells load, beta1 moves); task switching happens only on an EXECUTE verdict in the zone of proximal development.

ideas.name: The law, the receipts, the honest negative
ideas.statement: gamma + eta <= C = log2(3) scaled to 1585 is enforced exactly at the integers; every experiment is a receipt chain with byte-identical replay; R3's honest negative is that the law is NEVER-BOUND in vivo at these parameters — the boundary test carries the guarantee.

parts.name: Fixed-point scaled-integer substrate
parts.essence: All ledger quantities are scaled integers (unit 1/1000 bit): C_SCALED=1585, ETA_SCALE=2000, gamma constants — no floating-point nondeterminism in JEPA or DoubleEntry cells; vibe floats accumulate through a fixed op order.
parts.gate: Boundary tolerance 1e-9 scaled units — comparisons are exact at the integers
parts.failure_mode: Float drift would break byte-identical replay (seed3 §4.1 determinism demand)

parts.name: Checkpointable randomness
parts.essence: mulberry32 single-uint32 RNG plus a stateless keyed flicker bit (fnv1a64 of worldSeed:evalN:i) — no hidden rng state, so any mid-run checkpoint replays bit-identically.
parts.gate: Every draw must be recoverable from (seed, index) alone
parts.failure_mode: Hidden RNG state would make resume divergence silent

parts.name: Entropy vault over real cached packets
parts.essence: DbaVault reads REAL cached moth packets from disk (moth-holdem.json, moth-e16.json), stretches them into a bit pool (fnv1a64 counter-mode), hard-labeled live:false / mock:true — a mock never pretends to be quantum.
parts.gate: Monobit sanity: pool rejected unless ones-ratio in (0.4, 0.6)
parts.failure_mode: A degenerate pool would correlate world randomness; monobit throws on breach

parts.name: Deterministic world generation
parts.essence: 16x16 grid, 4 hazard blocks and 4 zones x 10 food items generated deterministically from worldSeed; hazards never overlap and never sit on the start cell.
parts.gate: Start cell (8,8) is never a hazard
parts.failure_mode: Overlapping hazards would silently shrink the world

parts.name: Z_in sensors
parts.essence: sensors.vision = inverse L1 distance to nearest reward scaled to salience 0..1000; sensors.proprio = own position {x,y,t}.
parts.gate: Salience clamped to [0,1000] (smoke pins 440 -> in range)
parts.failure_mode: Unbounded salience would spike the reflex path

parts.name: JEPA predict + integer surprise
parts.essence: world.predict: momentum next-position (pos + (pos - prev), clamped) + reward guess from memory.semantic; world.surprise: |dpos|*250 + reward_miss*500 — integer L1 surprise, eta.
parts.gate: Surprise is a pure integer function of state — recomputable at any checkpoint
parts.failure_mode: Prediction drift would corrupt the competence signal that gates growth

parts.name: Pincher reflex fast path
parts.essence: reflex.orient fires at salience > 800 (no teacher, no deliberation); when it fires, policy.action is overridden by pure salience climb.
parts.gate: Strictly salience > 800 — the threshold is the whole reflex policy
parts.failure_mode: Reflex hijack of deliberate action near rewards is the intended fast path, not a bug

parts.name: Growth: adding cells IS advancing stages
parts.essence: state.stage accumulates position only while surprise declines (gain/50 clamped 0..10); position >= 1000 loads the stage-2 sheet (sensors.language + teacher.label, policy.action reads them) via engine.loadSheet; skills.graph beta1 = E - V + C moves -1 -> 1.
outputs: grown sheet with new live cells
parts.gate: Position accrues ONLY on declining surprise (competence, not reward)
parts.failure_mode: Reward alone never grows the sheet — E-D1 R2: unguided arm 10 vs 24500 position

parts.name: DoubleEntry conservation law
parts.essence: ledger.gamma = 100 base + 150 per teacher consult; ledger.eta = surprise; ledger.check: gamma + eta <= 1585 ? ok : refuse; conservation.test probes the boundary input-driven — 1585 passes, 1586 refuses exactly.
parts.gate: gamma + eta <= C = log2(3) x 1000, exact at the scaled integers
parts.failure_mode: R3 honest negative: never breached in vivo at these parameters — the boundary test carries the guarantee

parts.name: JEV typed-decision gate (mock calibration)
parts.essence: teacher.jev_gate: p = 0.5 + 0.5*tanh((success - 0.75)*8) over the last-100 success ring; > 0.95 execute, 0.70-0.95 escalate, < 0.70 discard; LABELED mock:true, every consult logged in teacher.jev_log.
parts.gate: Every gate row carries the mock label — the OFF voice never impersonates live judgment
parts.failure_mode: Unlabeled mock would fake a live JEV verdict

parts.name: Curriculum switching policy
parts.essence: teacher.feedback: in jev-gated mode only an EXECUTE verdict with noul > 0.95 switches the task, and only upward (easy -> hard, zone of proximal development); unguided arm D switches every 500 evals as the control.
parts.gate: Only EXECUTE + noul > 0.95 + task < 3 may switch — and never downward
parts.failure_mode: Unguided switching grows rewards but never development (E-D1 R2 control)

parts.name: Live typesafe SystemOne client, fail-closed
parts.essence: One batched POST /v1/systemone answers N typed questions (noul/choice/score) in ~334ms; four budget caps; one retry then FAIL CLOSED to the sheet's mock gate with fallback_used:true; positive AND negative decisions disk-cached for zero-call bit-identical replay.
outputs: typed answers + usage tokens, journaled with prompt HASH
parts.gate: A live gate that cannot answer must never stall the loop and must never silently pretend — every row labeled live|cache|negcache|budget_mock|fail_closed_*
parts.failure_mode: Endpoint migration (.dev NXDOMAIN -> .ai) receipted; 429/5xx -> fail-closed not crash

parts.name: Live moth QRC stochasticity lane
parts.essence: E-D3: probe FIRST (1 tiny job), inspect result shapes, then choose the engine that yields genuine per-bit variability (coin-toss aggregate vs graph-v1 distinct 8-bit outcome keys vs qpixl decode-noise floats); stream = concatenated job payloads in submission order; caps MAX_JOBS=10, MIN_BITS=4096.
outputs: cached quantum randomness stream with provenance
parts.gate: A batch is labeled live:true/mock:false ONLY if a real job completed
parts.failure_mode: Jobs with no extractable per-bit payload still contribute provenance + H/T stats, never fake bits

parts.name: Receipt chains + byte-identical replay
parts.essence: Each experiment appends receipt rows (21/28/17 rows for E-D1/2/3) sealed by fnv1a64 chains; E-D1 R5 replays from a mid-run checkpoint byte-identically (full_hash == resumed_hash 1de2f9c27e8d); the derived world seed is stored in bundles so replay never re-reads the vault mid-run.
parts.gate: verifyChain over the re-read file must pass; resumed hash must equal full hash
parts.failure_mode: Any mid-run mutation breaks the chain or the replay equality

parts.name: Key hygiene doctrine
parts.essence: Keys load AT RUNTIME only (env, then .env regex), held in closure, NEVER written to any file, log, receipt, journal or console; journal rows carry prompt HASHes; selfScan() re-checks written text against the live key.
parts.gate: No key material may appear in any artifact — selfScan must find zero matches
parts.failure_mode: An unsanitized exception string once leaked a credential in cot-quilt — this doctrine is the fix

cells.expr: 1000 - 80*min L1 distance to a reward, clamped 0..1000
position += clamp(floor(gain/50),0,10) only while surprise declines
{mode:'offline-stream', live:false} — vault over cached real packets

layer_logic.0: Substrate: scaled-integer fixed-point arithmetic, checkpointable RNG, and an entropy vault of real cached packets hard-labeled live:false — determinism first, honesty about entropy second.
layer_logic.1: Mechanisms: deterministic world, salience sensors, JEPA predict/surprise, reflex override, and growth-as-cell-addition — the sheet literally gains cells when competence accrues.
layer_logic.2: Policy: the conservation law (gamma+eta<=C exact at integers), the calibrated mock JEV gate, and curriculum switching gated to EXECUTE verdicts — reward is decoupled from development.
layer_logic.3: Interfaces: a fail-closed batched live LLM gate (budgeted, cached, labeled) and a probe-first live quantum randomness lane — both wires keep honest labels in every row.
layer_logic.4: Evidence: per-experiment receipt chains, byte-identical checkpoint replay, monobit pool sanity, and the receipted honest negative that the law is never bound in vivo — the boundary test carries the guarantee.
